sample_unit: patients and controls (structural MRI scans across training, independent research, and clinical datasets)

links.outcome: Generalization of MRI psychiatric classifier to independent research and real-world clinical data
links.effect: Generalizability confirmed on independent research datasets (n = 1,346) and real-world clinical data (n = 344) after training on n = 2,490; no numeric performance given in abstract.
links.quote: Trained on a large, curated dataset (n = 2,490) of four major disorders and controls, the PHN's generalizability was confirmed on independent research datasets (n = 1,346) and real-world clinical data (n = 344).

screen.reason: The study develops a deep learning framework for psychiatric classification from MRI and evaluates its implementation/deployment into an active clinical workflow, but does not test a specific safeguard/deployment practice comparison.
